commits.message:
feat: add agent parallelism default and bypass permissions to CLAUDE.md

- Always default to parallel subagents for 2+ independent tasks
- Use bypass/auto-approve permissions to avoid gating progress

Applied to both project-level and user-level CLAUDE.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: add project health check step to end-session skill

Adds Step 3b that runs build/test/lint commands documented in
the project's CLAUDE.md before wrapping up. Catches regressions
before committing. Skips silently if no commands are documented.

Promoted from project-specific overrides (Golf, PDB) into the
generic skill as a universal pattern.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: merge start-session skill versions and add config sync step

Merges both diverged versions into one canonical file:
- Ticket parsing (from runtime version)
- Rename-session, Definition of Done, scope expansion, context
  anxiety monitoring (from repo version)
- New Pre-Flight Step 4: one-way sync from claude-config → ~/.claude/skills
  with FYI notifications for project overrides

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: sync end-session skill — add ticket tracking from runtime version

Merges ticket tracking (from ~/.claude runtime version) into the
claude-config version. Both copies now have identical content:
Docker auto-rebuild, adversarial self-eval, ticket tracking, and
session title re-apply.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: add Docker auto-rebuild step to end-session skill

Adds Step 6 to end-session that detects Docker infrastructure,
checks if session changes affect container-related files, and
auto-rebuilds with docker compose. Non-blocking on failure.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #1 from GammageATX/claude/add-tips-slash-commands-ehPMr

Add harness design tips from Anthropic blog to session skills

feat: add rename-session skill and integrate with start/end-session

- New rename-session skill for programmatic session title setting via .jsonl
- start-session: rename after user confirms focus (works in VS Code)
- end-session: re-apply title at session end to combat 64KB eviction
- Updated step numbering in start/end session skills
- Added rename-session to README component table

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Initial commit: shared Claude Code config

User preferences (CLAUDE.md) and shared skills for session management,
agent teams, parallel worktrees, and write-review workflows. Designed
to be consumed as a git submodule by all projects.
